list.title: Contact Staff
list.sub: Inquiries are organized by subject. Each one is handled by a department and has a status you can follow.
list.empty: You haven't opened any inquiries yet
list.emptyBody: Write to a department with any question about {{name}}.

new.title: New inquiry
new.whoTitle: Who would you like to contact?
new.whoSub: Choose the department that can best help. If you're not sure, choose "Other" and the social worker will route it.
new.subject: Subject
new.subjectHelp: A short title helps the team find your inquiry quickly.

new.attachHelp: Up to 5 files, 10 MB each. JPG, PNG or PDF.
new.urgent: This is not for emergencies. For anything urgent, call the nurses' station at <ltr>{{phone}}</ltr>
new.offline: Connect to the internet to send your inquiry.
new.discardBody: What you wrote will not be saved.

sent.title: Your inquiry was sent
sent.body: The {{dept}} team received it. You'll get a notification when they reply, usually within {{expected}}.
sent.subject: Subject

desc.closed: This inquiry is closed and kept for your records.
